subject: MAP: Load / performance test scheduling (traffic replay, peak QPS, capacity sizing)
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@acme.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 25 Jun 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call recap + MAP draft (load test scheduling)

Alex — thanks again for the productive call today. As promised, attached is the MAP draft (v1.3) focused on the load/performance milestone so we can lock a test window and size dedicated capacity: MAP highlights below and asks for your confirmation.

Key MAP milestone (Load / Performance Test)
- Objective: Replay production traffic to validate latency, throughput, and cost at peak QPS before go-live.
- Proposed test window: 2026-07-15 – prefer morning PT start (10:00)
- Test plan: 30m warmup, 2h smoke at 50% peak, 4h sustained at reported peak QPS, 30m cooldown.
- Responsibilities:
  - Acme: Provide traffic replay artifacts (sample logs or S3 replay bundle), confirm peak QPS and SLA targets.
  - Redwood (marissa/aditya/vivek): Environment provisioning (dedicated GPUs), run replay, collect metrics, produce report.
- Dependencies: Dedicated capacity reservation, network peering (if using private VPC), ingestion of replay artifacts, SLO targets.
- Target close for MAP milestone: 2026-07-20 (finish test & share results)

Attachments: MAP-v1.3.xlsx (MAP with milestones/responsibilities), traffic-replay-instructions.pdf (how we replay logs).

Ask: Can you confirm peak QPS for the workload, the size of the replay bundle (GB), and whether Acme will provide an S3 link or prefer Redwood to run an agent inside your environment? With that info we'll finalize the capacity estimate and lock the reservation.

I copied Aditya (infra) and Vivek (account ops) to get initial sizing input. If the proposed 2026-07-15 window works, tell us preferred start time and we�ll send a formal scheduling invite and pre-test checklist.

Thanks,
Marissa
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | (650) 555-0147
Redwood Inference

From: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@acme.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Megan Sanders <megan.sanders@acme.com>
Date: Fri, 26 Jun 2026 09:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + MAP draft (load test scheduling)

Marissa — thanks for the notes and the MAP. Quick answers below:

- Confirmed peak QPS: 12,500 peak (observed 95th percentile over last 30 days).
- Replay bundle size: ~48GB compressed (we can provide a tar.gz on S3).
- Preferred approach: provide an S3 bundle with instructions; we�re not in a position to host an agent inside our VPC for this first test.
- Availability: the 2026-07-15 window looks OK. Prefer start at 10:00 PT. Megan (cc'd) will coordinate any required network access with our infra team.

Couple questions:
1) Can Redwood provide a preliminary capacity estimate (GPU count / memory) so we can sign off on reservation?
2) What monitoring hooks do you need from our side (metrics, traces, auth keys)?

We appreciate the detail in the MAP. Once we see your capacity suggestion we'll confirm the reservation.

Thanks,
Alex
Senior SRE, Acme Corp
alex.johnson@acme.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@acme.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 28 Jun 2026 11:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call recap + MAP draft (load test scheduling)

Alex — great, thanks for the numbers and the S3 delivery preference. Drafting capacity and ops plan below so you have something to review before we lock the reservation.

Redwood proposed capacity & test plan (initial estimate)
- Dedicated pool: 4 x A100-class GPUs (or equivalent)
- Instance sizing rationale: supports 12.5k QPS replay with headroom for KV cache and bursty traffic; allows parallelism across shards for latency SLOs.
- Warmup: 30 minutes at 20% QPS to populate KV cache and stabilize kernels.
- Tests: 2h smoke at ~6k QPS + 4h sustained at 12.5k QPS. Capture per-token latency distribution, GPU metrics, and request/response traces.
- Expected outputs: latency P50/P90/P99, token throughput, tail latency breakdowns, cost estimate for sustained run.

Ops checklist (attached ops-checklist.txt) includes pre-test items (VPC peering, auth keys, S3 read test), runbook steps, and rollback conditions.

Action items for Acme:
- Share S3 replay bundle link and IAM read role (or pre-signed URLs) by 2026-07-08.
- Confirm any IP allowlists for Redwood test runners.
- Confirm whether traces/headers must be redacted.

Aditya / Vivek: please confirm the above capacity estimate and flag if we should upsell to 6 GPUs for additional headroom. Also call out any setup lead times for dedicated capacity reservations.

If all OK from your side, we�ll send a calendar invite for 2026-07-15 10:00 PT and start the reservation.

Best,
Marissa

From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@acme.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 29 Jun 2026 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP: Load / performance test scheduling (traffic replay, peak QPS, capacity sizing)

Marissa / Alex — quick infra notes from my side:

- Capacity: 4 x A100-class GPUs is a reasonable starting point. For 12.5k QPS sustained with typical request sizes (avg 120 tokens) we should be ok, but if Acme expects 300-token tails or complex tool-calling we should size to 6 GPUs.
- Warmup & KV cache: ensure warmup runs include representative prefix distribution; otherwise first-run tail latency will be inflated.
- Networking: we need either a pre-signed S3 URL for the bundle or an IAM role with s3:GetObject. If the S3 is in a private bucket, we need peering or VPN.
- Monitoring hooks: we�ll ingest request_id, timestamp, and latency headers. If you can provide x-request-id or equivalent we can map traces.
- Lead time: dedicated pool reservation for 4 GPUs can be provisioned in ~48 hours; 6 GPUs may take 72 hours depending on current allocations.

Related ticket: SUP-3421 (internal) will track pre-test ops; I�ve added placeholders for the account and the proposed 2026-07-15 window.

I�ll prepare a short runbook and confirm cost estimate by EOD Tue (2026-06-30).

Regards,
Aditya
Senior Infra Engineer | Redwood Inference
aditya.rao@redwood.com

From: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@acme.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Cc: Megan Sanders <megan.sanders@acme.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 02 Jul 2026 09:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: MAP: Load / performance test scheduling (traffic replay, peak QPS, capacity sizing)

Thanks, everyone. Confirming schedule and next steps:

- We will provide S3 bundle and pre-signed URLs by 2026-07-08. S3 link (test bundle): https://s3.amazonaws.com/acme-prod/traffic-replay/samples/20260624.tar.gz
- Peak QPS remains 12,500; test start confirmed for 2026-07-15 10:00 PT.
- We accept the initial 4 GPU sizing; if telemetry during warmup shows memory pressure we can agree to a mid-test scale to 6 GPUs.
- Monitoring: we will include x-request-id and x-acme-trace headers in the replay.

Megan will coordinate IAM creds and peering where necessary. Please send calendar invite and final runbook once SUP-3421 is updated with provisioning details.

Appreciate the partnership here 2— looking forward to the test.
